who.value: buyer watching a fashion or TCG live show

stage.value: transaction — Buy Now during a live show

job.value: See the product and model clearly enough to decide whether to buy

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The live video, product card 'S$8900' with 'Sale 14:59' and the 'Buy now' button make it clearly a live sale.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Buy now' button is the strongest element in both frames.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Wallet', 'Unmute', 'Share' and 'Shop' each name what they open or do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '3 left', 'Sale' and 'See show notes for shipping details' need no explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only decision is buy or not, from the price and stock shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Shipping detail is behind 'See show notes for shipping details'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every element serves watching and buying during the show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Price, stock and timer carry it; chat is ambient content, not instructions.
